summary.text: Peter Appollonio Jr. is a Democratic state senator from Rhode Island who has represented District 29 since 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Peter Appollonio Jr. earned a bachelor's degree from Rhode Island College.
His career experience includes working for the West Warwick Police Department and as a substitute teacher for Warwick Public Schools.
He took office in the State Senate on January 7, 2025, succeeding Anthony DeLuca, and advanced from the Democratic primary on September 9, 2026.
